entries.value: the payment is due a season early
the road is closed by a landslide
someone has been forging her signature
a debt is sold to a stranger
the wrong person is praised for her work
a letter arrives addressed to a name she abandoned
the council wants a decision by morning
her best tool breaks with no replacement
an old rival returns with better manners
the ferry stops running for a week
a promised favor is called in at the worst hour
